This baseline is a ratchet CEILING: the live set must stay a SUBSET of this list. A metric REMOVED from this baseline because it was wrongly added (not because it was fixed) is not a 'SHRUNK' event in the ordinary sense -- it is a baseline correction, recorded here rather than silently dropped.
